nodes.label: Channels in Market Analysis
nodes.description: Understanding how market price action is contained within various channel structures.

nodes.label: General Channel Concept
nodes.description: The market is often in some kind of channel, sometimes simultaneously in several across different time frames, defined by price action confined between a pair of lines.

nodes.label: Trend Channel
nodes.description: A diagonal channel contained by a trend line and a trend channel line.

nodes.label: Bear Channel
nodes.description: Has a descending trend line above (bear trend line) and a descending trend channel line below (bear trend channel line).

nodes.label: Trading Range
nodes.description: Contained between a horizontal support line below and a resistance line above.

nodes.label: Weak Trend Channel
nodes.description: A trading range that is slightly rising or falling.

nodes.label: Triangles
nodes.description: Areas of price action contained between two lines, exhibiting trending behavior (higher highs/lower lows) in addition to trading range behavior.

nodes.label: Expanding Triangle
nodes.description: Contained between two diverging lines, both technically trend channel lines.

nodes.label: Lower Line (Expanding Triangle)
nodes.description: Across lower lows, below a bear trend, thus a trend channel line.

nodes.label: Upper Line (Expanding Triangle)
nodes.description: Across higher highs, thus a bull trend channel line.

nodes.label: Contracting Triangle
nodes.description: Contained between two trend lines, indicating both a small bear trend (lower highs) and a bull trend (higher lows).

nodes.label: Ascending Triangle
nodes.description: Has a resistance line above and a bull trend line below.

nodes.label: Descending Triangle
nodes.description: Has a support line below and a bear trend line above.

nodes.label: Wedge
nodes.description: A variant of a triangle; an ascending or descending channel where the trend line and trend channel line converge.

nodes.label: ABC Correction
nodes.description: A type of channel that occurs during corrections in trends.

nodes.label: In Bull Trend
nodes.description: Appears as a small bear channel.

nodes.label: In Bear Trend
nodes.description: Appears as a small bull channel.
